Name: Drink More Water (CP)
Author: Warilized
Description:
Please drink more water, re-hydrate yourself.

[center]-------------------------------[/center]
[size=4][b]About this mod:
[/b][/size]This is a Content Patcher Mod (formerly a Json Asset mod). It adds drinkable water so you can re-hydrate yourself. This mod is designed to be new farmer friendly.

[size=4][b]What's New:[/b][/size][list]
[*]Converting from Json Asset to Content Patcher for ease of updating and developing.
[*]Adds Joja Water.
[*]Various shop tweak.
[*]New Gift taste (still in progress)
[*]New Chinese translation
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]First, you need to [b]delete past version[/b] (below 2.0.0)
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed, or else this mod is useless.
[*]If this is your first installation, skip this step. Before placing the mod into "Mods" folder, deleting old mod file ([b][JA] Drink More Water[/b]) is recommended to avoid some problems (especially if you are updating from [b]version 1.4[/b]).
[*]Unzip this mod to "Mods" folder.
[*]Done
[/list]
[b][size=4]Uninstallation:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Delete the mod.
[*]Done.
[/list]
[b][size=4]This Mod Contains:[/size][/b]
This mod comes with several different types of H2O:[list]
[*]Raw Water
[*]Water
[*]Bottled Water (Aquafine)
[*]Ionized Water (Carry Sweat)*
[*]Purified Water (Pure Slime)*
[*]Joja Water*
[/list]
*Can't be crafted, only machine produce

[b][size=4]Optional Files [color=#FF0000](DEPRECATED, SEE NOTES)[/color]:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Kettle (Crafting, default): 10 Woods, 5 Stones. Can be bought at Robin's. Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]﻿﻿.
Used as alternative to cooking if player doesn't have kitchen stuff installed (upgraded house). Boils 4 cups of Raw Water to 4 glass of Water. Needs 1 wood to operate.[*]Rainwater Tank (Crafting, default): 10 Woods, 10 Stones, 5 Fibers. C[font=Arial]an be bought at R[/font]obin's. Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]﻿﻿.
Gather rainwater when it is raining outside. Only works when it is raining. Produces 10 cups of Raw Water in 100 game ticks.[*]Water Pump (Crafting, default): 15 Woods, 10 Stones, 5 Fibers. Can be bought at Robin's. Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]﻿﻿.
Pumps water from inside of the Earth. Only works outdoor. Produces 20 cups of Raw Water in 300 game ticks.[/list]
[b][size=4]Notes:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Due to few circumstances, I'll release the machine (BigCraftables) as a separate mod and only focuses this mod for Crafting and Cooking recipes.
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4][b]Planned Updates:[/b][/size][list]
[*]BigCraftables
[*]New kind of Water
[/list][b][size=2] [/size]
[size=4]Disclaimer:[/size][/b]
This mod is only available only on NexusMods or Playstarbound Forum (if available) under "Warilized" username.
